requirements.text: A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable hands-on experience.
At least 3 years of experience building production software across the full application stack.
Advanced skill in Rust or a comparable programming language, plus a solid command of Python.
A proven track record in systems design, data flow architecture, performance-sensitive code, and API design.
A firm grasp of software quality practices, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines in live production settings.
Outstanding communication skills and the ability to lead technical solutions on your own within an early-stage hardware/software company.
Hands-on experience building medical device software under design controls and quality standards such as IEC 62304.
Practical experience creating HIPAA-compliant platforms that manage sensitive information (PHI/PII).
Knowledge of biological sensor data, time-series data, or neurophysiological signal processing workflows.
A background in applying cybersecurity best practices to connected device ecosystems.
